texto_en: New-build works licence and amendments (Licencia de Obras)
First occupancy licence (Licencia de Primera Ocupación)
Designs and responsible declarations for extensions and/or mobile-home installation
Registration of the propane gas installation
Previous technical reports: due diligences, specific studies (facades, structure, installations, …)
Electricity and water consumption invoices (domestic and fire-protection supply)
Details of the drainage pumping system and the discharge authorisation to the public sewer
Final works certificate (Certificado Final de Obra)
Maintenance contracts in the owner's name (fire protection, electrical, substation, etc.)
Maintenance reports for the installations in the owner's name (fire protection, electrical, substation, etc.)
Mandatory statutory inspections of the installations (fire protection, electrical, HVAC, gas, etc.)
Registration with the Industry authority of low-voltage electrical installations / electrical certificates and high voltage
Registration of thermal installations (air conditioning, heating and domestic hot water)
Registration with the Industry authority of thermal installations (solar thermal)
Registration with the Industry authority of the fire-protection installation
Application submitted to obtain the environmental licence
Inspection reports issued by the environmental authority or an accredited body
Correspondence with the environmental authority on environmental matters
Geotechnical report and any soil quality or contamination investigations carried out
Preliminary soil quality report and the authority's response

Description of the existing tanks (above and below ground) – type, volume, contents, age, tightness tests, etc. (include fuel tanks for generators, fire pumps, etc., and former tanks out of use or decommissioned). Attach a location drawing if available
Schedule of chemical products stored by hazard class. Quantities stored (and consumed annually)
Latest Seveso report (if applicable) and the authority's response

If chemical substances are imported from outside the European customs territory (>1t), include the substance pre-registration documentation. If a downstream user, include the correspondence with suppliers on pre-registrations. If an importer of articles, include the documentation on the control of SVHC substances in them
Inventory of emission sources (boilers included), classification and measurement reports of air pollutants
If there is refrigeration equipment, the gas it uses
Annual quantities of solvents used. Fugitive emissions balance and solvent management plan
For cooling towers, attach the analyses and controls carried out for legionella control
If there is a well on site, the water abstraction authorisation and its analysis
Description of any pre-treatment applied to the supply water
Discharge permit for waste water and rainwater (state where it discharges, to a watercourse or to the municipal sewer)
Description of the treatment applied to the waste water before discharge
Analyses carried out on the waste water
Documentation on waste management (hazardous and non-hazardous), waste producer number
Inventory of asbestos-containing materials on site
If there are oil-filled electrical transformers or hydraulic equipment, their year and the PCB content analysis of the oil in that equipment
Environmental investment plan for the next 5 years
Environmental certifications (ISO 14001, EMAS, etc.). Include any other certifications held (ISO 9001, 18001, etc.)
Environmental incidents over the history of the plant
Aspects that would improve the building's efficiency and/or performance, although not required due to regulatory non-compliance, necessary repair, or renewal due to end of useful life.

Anomalies due to age (parts of the property that have exceeded their useful life) which, although currently may not be negatively and substantially affecting operations, we believe will require renovation to be addressed in the transaction.
Anomalies that may be interpreted as non-compliant but are open to interpretation and could be negotiated without becoming relevant to the transaction.

Irrefutable anomalies expected to be claimed by the buyer requiring a commitment to resolve within an agreed timeframe. This group includes anomalies that by their nature affect building deterioration, may constitute a clear breach of current regulations and/or may impact operations.
